parts.text: We have an exciting opportunity to join our HCI team at St Andrews School of Computer Science as a Lecturer in Research and Teaching –

We are seeking a dynamic, collegial individual who values teaching and research, to support the expansion and development of the HCI group. Applications welcome from all areas of HCI from candidates with diverse research portfolios that span the areas of HCI, Design and Computer Science. Particular areas of interest include, but are not limited to: tangible computing, digital fabrication, ubiquitous computing, information visualization, creative technology and design, augmented reality, novel software and hardware interactions, and HCI for good including ‘wicked’ problems such as societal injustices and inequalities, data ethics & privacyand environmental sustainability. Expertise in the field of HCI and technical expertise in the creation of hardware and or software interactions is of particular interest.

Deadline: 1st May

Interviews: 27th May

Job Description:
